products.name: IrisGo for Solopreneurs
products.tagline: AI workflow automation: show it once, let it run
products.description: IrisGo helps solopreneurs automate recurring work. Get daily briefs, triage email, track to-dos, and turn demonstrated tasks into reusable workflows with Watch & Learn. Spend less time on admin and more time building your business. Free during beta.

products.name: GenPage 3.0
products.tagline: Build, personalize, and optimize landing pages with AI
products.description: Your marketing campaigns are personalized. Your landing pages should be too. GenPage learns your brand, builds dedicated pages for every ad, keyword, or target account, then continuously A-Z tests them on Autopilot - turning more traffic into pipeline and revenue.

products.name: Velozity
products.tagline: The Multiplayer AI Office where your team and agents work.
products.description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.

products.name: Databench by Alkera
products.tagline: Open-source collaborative agentic workspace for data teams
products.description: Databench by Alkera is the open-source, multiplayer workspace for data science, analytics, and engineering. Collaborate live alongside teammates and agents in notebooks and chats, run any cell or agent on your laptop, another computer, or a GPU node and launch many agents in parallel to explore ideas. Every result traces back to the data and code behind it. Try it at https://alkera.ai with a generous free tier or host Databench yourself (https://github.com/AlkeraAI/Databench).

products.name: Pegasus 1.6 by TwelveLabs
products.tagline: Transforms egocentric video into robot training data
products.description: Pegasus 1.6 is the TwelveLabs model that understands video from a first-person point of view, built for the egocentric and teleoperated footage robotics and physical AI teams already collect. It recognizes entities more accurately, and produces persistent metadata across segment types. Point it at raw teleoperation or wearable footage and get back labeled, timestamped, robot-ready data. No manual labeling pass required.

products.name: Figma Agent
products.tagline: Prompt, edit and prototype without leaving the canvas
products.description: Figma's agent lives right on the Design canvas and works with your real components, variables and team files, not flat images. Generate layout directions, bulk-edit across screens, turn comments into changes and build prototypes from a prompt. Pull context from Notion, Slack, GitHub and Linear via MCP, build your own plugins and shaders, and save repeatable workflows as skills your team runs with "/". Stay in flow from idea to review.

products.name: Mistral Large 4
products.tagline: Mistral's 1T parameter open weight frontier model
products.description: Mistral Large 4 (aka Le Chonk) is Mistral's largest model yet: a natively multimodal mixture of experts model with 1T total and 49B active parameters and a 1M token context window. Mistral says it is the strongest open weight model from the US or Europe, and it ranks top 5 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index. It was trained in Mistral's own European datacenters. The preview API is live today on Mistral Studio, with open weights due by the end of October.

products.name: Supademo AI Demo Agent
products.tagline: Agentic demos like your best salesperson, without the salary
products.description: Most AI demo agents feel like a video call where the other side isn't really listening. Silly animated avatar or obvious fake person on the other end. You ask a question, they keep talking. You try to navigate, but you're just watching their screen. Why bother? Supademo's AI Demo Agent is the opposite. Buyers click through real interactive demos hands-on, take any path, jump back, skip ahead. The agent listens, answers the actual question, surfaces the right proof. Voice or text, 50+ languages.

products.name: Rool
products.tagline: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace.
products.description: Rool is your private AI workspace. Bring your files, ideas and AI together in one place, on your own machine in the cloud. Unlike mainstream AI, Rool never sells your data, shows no ads and never uses your content to train AI. Your data is stored in Finland, under EU law. It's AI that runs on your terms, with full control and privacy. Built for privacy-conscious individuals, teams and creators. Try Rool free and own your AI.

products.name: Ownfeed
products.tagline: A social feed of people who need your product
products.description: Paste your product's URL. Every day, Ownfeed reads Reddit, X, Bluesky and Hacker News and keeps only the posts from people who need what you built. No keywords, no alert inbox, no auto-replies. You scroll for five minutes and reply yourself.

products.name: Nano Banana 2.1
products.tagline: Google's image model with sharper design and mask editing
products.description: Nano Banana 2.1 is Google's latest image generation and editing model. Google says it outperforms earlier Nano Banana models across the board, with better visual design, mask based editing, stronger subject consistency and more natural looking images. It also improves text rendering and consistency across turns, with Search grounding at 1K, 2K and 4K. Try it in Google AI Studio or the Gemini app, or build with it in the Gemini API and Google Cloud.

products.name: Proofsource
products.tagline: AI search visibility, with agents that fix the gaps
products.description: When a buyer asks ChatGPT for the best tool in your category, it names five or six companies and stops. Proofsource shows whether you're one of them. It asks your buyers' questions on ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews every day, shows who gets named instead and why, maps the pages AI trusts, and drafts the fixes. You approve; our agents publish, verify the answers changed, and learn from every change. Start free: 25 questions, 4 engines, no card.

products.name: Introducing Video Editor in Manus 2.0
products.tagline: Anyone Can Now Make A Video Worth Posting
products.description: Manus 2.0 introduces Video Editor, making professional-looking video creation accessible to everyone. After a month of daily use, Manus has been used to create launch films, game trailers, news explainers, beat-synced animations, and even edit travel footage. The new Video Editor combines Manus’ AI video capabilities with powerful editing workflows, helping anyone turn ideas and raw footage into polished videos worth posting.

products.name: ParakeetAI 2.0
products.tagline: The ultimate way to prepare for your job interview
products.description: ParakeetAI takes you from "what will they ask?" to "I nailed it." Start with the Question Bank: real interview questions grouped by company and ranked by how often they come up. Rehearse them out loud with an AI interviewer that asks, listens and follows up on your answers, then read the transcript back. On the day, ParakeetAI listens to the real interview and drafts your answers live. Your first mock interview is free.

products.name: Rhem Labs
products.tagline: Health assistant robots for your parents’
products.description: Aging at home has a visibility problem. Small changes in health and routine can go unnoticed for weeks or months, until the first obvious sign is something serious. Rhem is a tabletop robot that helps families see those changes earlier, while giving parents the everyday support they need to stay independent longer. Rhem was designed first for aging parents, but anyone can use it as an extra set of eyes and everyday help at home.
